3) EU VAT: Nimbus, please drop the exact VAT handling language you need (a short bullet is fine). We'll fold it into the DocuSign envelope as a redlineable clause.

I've uploaded a slightly updated checklist to our shared hub link and added a row for payer-account mapping. See: https://drive.redwood.com/s/CPPO-activation/Nimbus-4891 (internal link).
